Eternal Might.tagline: Zombie tokens that loot, recur and drain.
Eternal Might.plan: Temmet loots on every attack and pumps your Zombies with each draw. Discarded creatures return as 4/4 Zombie copies.

Living Energy.tagline: Energy, artifacts and a 5/5 copy every combat.
Living Energy.plan: Saheeli turns artifact spells into energy and copies your best permanent each combat. Lightning Runner and Aetherwind Basker can loop extra combats.

Counter Intelligence.tagline: Counters, proliferate and two ways to win out of nowhere.
Counter Intelligence.plan: Station Inspirit to protect your artifacts, pile counters everywhere and multiply them, then win with Darksteel Reactor or Lux Artillery.

World Shaper.tagline: Sacrifice lands, make giants, drain the table.
World Shaper.plan: Hearthhull draws cards by sacrificing lands and, fully stationed, drains 2 from each opponent per land. Landfall makes tokens and extra combats.
